_about: SERIES SHELF of the Harvard Oriental Series translations into English before 1931 (ed. Charles Rockwell Lanman, 1891 onward): Whitney's Atharva-Veda (1905), Keith's Black Yajus and Rigveda Brahmanas (1914, 1920), Macdonell's Brhad-Devata (1904), Woods's Yoga-System of Patanjali (1914), Lanman's Karpura-manjari (1901) and Belvalkar's Uttara-Rama-Charita (1915). Warren's Buddhism in Translations and Burlingame's Buddhist Legends (HOS 3, 28-30) are on pali-buddhist-translations; Ryder's Little Clay Cart (HOS 9) is on the ryder shelf. Each title gates on its own translator. First printings only; the Motilal Banarsidass reprints of the 1960s-70s that share these titles on archive.org are not used. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 66); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
